verify.test: bash -c 'cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" || exit 1; bad=$( { for f in .claude-plugin/marketplace.json docs/shared-lines-allowlist.txt skill/work-pr/SKILL.md skill/work-issue/SKILL.md; do [ -f "$f" ] || echo "MISSING INPUT $f"; done; jq empty $(git ls-files "*.json") || echo "INVALID JSON"; jq -r ".plugins[] | (.skills // [])[]" .claude-plugin/marketplace.json | sort -u | while read -r p; do [ -f "$p/SKILL.md" ] || echo "BAD SKILL $p"; done; jq -r ".plugins[] | (.commands // [])[]" .claude-plugin/marketplace.json | sort -u | while read -r p; do case "$p" in *.md) [ -f "$p" ] || echo "MISSING COMMAND $p";; *) echo "NO .md EXTENSION $p";; esac; done; grep -Fxf skill/work-pr/SKILL.md skill/work-issue/SKILL.md | awk "length > 60" | grep -vFxf docs/shared-lines-allowlist.txt | sed "s/^/DUPLICATED /"; } 2>&1 ); [ -z "$bad" ] && echo "structural checks pass" || { echo "$bad"; exit 1; }'
